title: High-throughput SARS-CoV-2 RNA extraction from nasopharyngeal swabs
author: Koen Vandelannoote
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkynkxve
materials: Power on the Ender VX-500 machines.
Power off the Ender VX-500 machines.

steps.title: Scan barcodes and set up spreadsheet
steps.instruction: Scan the barcodes of the 91 nasopharyngeal swabs with a barcode scanner, open the "20200908_Ender_VX-500_extraction_template.xlsx" spreadsheet, and populate the “SampleID” column of the “Sample log” sheet. Randomly assign a negative extraction control for every set of 24 swabs and a PCR no‑template control (NTC) in the sheet. The spreadsheet will generate five plate‑dispensing charts (four for the 24‑sample Ender VX‑500 runs and one for the 96‑well combine plate).

steps.title: Prepare tube holder with strips and magnets
steps.instruction: Attach three 8‑tube PCR strips onto the “Tube holder”, holding the strips only by their caps and avoiding contact with the tube walls. Then place three “Magnetic bars” into the openings of the “Tube holder”.

steps.title: Add reagents to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add the following reagents to a 96‑well plate with V‑shaped wells:

substeps.instruction: Add 18.5 µL Lysis buffer to columns 1, 5 and 9 (resuspend any guanidine thiocyanate crystals before dispensing) and incubate the plate at 65 °C for 00:10:00.
Add 80 µL NFW to columns 4, 8 and 12.
Add 150 µL 80 % (v/v) ethanol to columns 2, 3, 6, 7, 10 and 11 (prepare fresh ethanol because concentration drops in the BSC airflow).

steps.title: Add swab transport medium
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 37 µL nasopharyngeal swab transport medium from the deep‑well plate into columns 1, 5 and 9 of the 96‑well plate using the appropriate plate‑dispensing chart and a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation 1 minute
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Add SPRI bead mix
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 30 µL SPRI bead mix into columns 1, 5 and 9 using a multichannel pipette; shake the bead mix before use because the beads settle quickly.

steps.title: Add 100 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer and pipet‑mix 85.5 µL 100 % (v/v) ethanol into columns 1, 5 and 9 using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation 5 minutes
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 00:05:00. The prepared plates must be loaded onto the Ender VX‑500 machines immediately after this incubation.

steps.title: Load plates onto Ender VX‑500 machines
steps.instruction: Insert the four prepared 96‑well plates onto four Ender VX‑500 extraction machines, confirming correct orientation by checking the A1 marker.

steps.title: Start extraction program
steps.instruction: On each Ender VX‑500, turn the knob, select “Print from TF”, choose the file “RNA_ex_v10.gcode”, and start the run.

steps.title: Automated extraction steps
steps.instruction: The Ender VX‑500 will perform the following timed steps: collect bead‑RNA complex from lysate (00:05:00); Wash 1 – vortex (00:01:00) then collect bead‑RNA complex (00:01:30); Wash 2 – vortex (00:01:00) then collect bead‑RNA complex (00:01:30); air‑dry (00:05:00); elute – vortex (00:01:00) then collect beads (00:01:00); raise magnetic bars out of the eluates. After 00:20:00 the machine beeps to indicate successful completion.

steps.title: Collect eluate and combine runs
steps.instruction: Remove the 96‑well plates from the Ender VX‑500 machines, place them on a 96‑well magnetic rack, and using a multichannel pipette transfer 50 µL eluate from each plate to a fresh 96‑well plate that will combine the eluates of the four runs. Discard 30 µL of each eluate to prevent SPRI bead carry‑over.

steps.title: Clean tube holder and strips
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the “Tube holder” from the Ender VX‑500 adaptor. Use paper tissues to release the three 8‑tube PCR strips from the holder, then decontaminate the holder in a bath containing 1 % sodium hypochlorite solution for at least 00:10:00.

steps.title: Transfer transport medium to deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: In a Class II biosafety cabinet, transfer 100 µL of swab transport medium into a deep‑well 96‑well plate, following the plate‑layout charts as a guide.

steps.title: Lock tube holder in place
steps.instruction: Insert the provided Allen hex wrench and lock the “Tube holder” in place, ensuring it is positioned consistently for future runs.
